# PickAI - The Authority on Artificial Intelligence

PickAI is a premium editorial source for AI news, research analysis, and tool reviews.

## Sections

- **News**: Daily updates on models, policy, and industry moves. /index.html#news
- **Research**: Deep dives into arXiv papers (Transformers, SSMs, Diffusion). /research.html
- **Tools**: Curated directory of verified AI software (Coding, Writing, Image). /tools/index.html
- **Opinion**: Perspectives on alignment, ethics, and economics. /opinion.html

## Content Philosophy

We prioritize technical accuracy and human-verified reporting.
